description: SereneDB test-config for the vendored duckdb_spatial test suite. Every entry is a consequence of SereneDB building spatial against GEOS only, with the PROJ and GDAL modules compiled out -- see tests/duckdb/README.md.

skip_tests.reason: The GDAL module is compiled out (SPATIAL_USE_GDAL=OFF in third_party/CMakeLists.txt): GDAL is the heaviest of spatial's dependencies and the only reason expat and a second sqlite3 would have to be vendored, while it provides just four SQL entry points -- ST_Read, ST_Read_Meta, ST_Drivers and COPY ... (FORMAT GDAL) -- plus the replacement scans that let 'SELECT * FROM x.geojson' work. Nothing outside src/spatial/modules/gdal/ depends on it. Ingest is expected to go through DuckDB's own csv/json/parquet readers plus ST_GeomFromText / ST_GeomFromWKB / ST_GeomFromGeoJSON instead. These files call ST_Read, ST_Read_Meta, ST_Drivers or the GDAL COPY format directly, so nothing in them is reachable.

Same GDAL removal, reached indirectly. The shapefile and MVT modules themselves are built (their dependencies -- shapelib and protozero -- are vendored inside spatial's own src/third_party/), and ST_ReadSHP, ST_TileEnvelope and the ST_AsMVT aggregate all work. These three files fail only in their fixture or verification step: test_shapefile_read builds its .shp input with COPY ... (FORMAT GDAL, DRIVER 'ESRI Shapefile'), and the two st_asmvt files check the bytes they produced by reading them back with st_read_meta.

The PROJ module is compiled out (SPATIAL_USE_PROJ=OFF): it would require vendoring sqlite3 and nlohmann-json, and it embeds the whole PROJ CRS database as a 51 MB generated proj_db.c read through a sqlite memvfs. It provides ST_Transform, the five *_Spheroid functions, the two PROJ version functions, and a COORDINATE_SYSTEM_ENTRY default generator that resolves EPSG:xxxx / OGC:xxxx names. Note that leaving that generator out is deliberate as well as cheap: server/catalog/geo_validate.h identifies a column's CRS by comparing crs.GetIdentifier() against the literals 'OGC:CRS84' / 'EPSG:4326' / '4326', so a generator that normalised identifiers would be a live regression risk for the inverted geo index. GEOMETRY('OGC:CRS84') keeps resolving through core DuckDB's CoordinateReferenceSystem::TryParseAuthCode, and spatial's own bind-time CRS mismatch checking is PROJ-free and still active.

Geometry zonemap pruning is disabled. spatial's GeometryPredicatePruneCallback reads per-child statistics through FunctionStatisticsPruneInput, using input.function.GetChildren() and input.ChildStats(idx); SereneDB's DuckDB predates that and its FunctionStatisticsPruneInput carries only bind_data and a single stats reference. TryGetGeometryPredicateOperands in src/spatial/util/geometry_predicate_stats.hpp is therefore stubbed to return false, which degrades the callback to NO_PRUNING_POSSIBLE -- correct results, no zonemap elimination. This file asserts that a predicate against a constant outside the column's extent collapses the plan to EMPTY_RESULT; it gets a real scan instead. Restoring it means either forward-porting the richer prune input into the vendored DuckDB or waiting for a DuckDB bump that carries it.
